name: Philip (the evangelist)
title: One of the seven and preacher in Samaria
summary: Philip was one of the seven men chosen to serve the church in Jerusalem. He preached the gospel in Samaria with great power and baptized the Ethiopian eunuch on the road to Gaza. Later, he lived in Caesarea with his four daughters who had the gift of prophecy.

keyEvents.title: Chosen among the seven
keyEvents.description: Philip, together with Stephen and five others, was chosen to serve at the tables so that the apostles could devote themselves to prayer and the Word.

keyEvents.title: Preacher in Samaria
keyEvents.description: Philip preached Christ in a city in Samaria, performed signs and wonders, and many came to faith and were baptized.

keyEvents.title: Baptizing the Ethiopian Official
keyEvents.description: Guided by the Spirit, Philip explained Isaiah's prophecy to an Ethiopian official and baptized him on the road to Gaza.

keyEvents.title: Paul's Host in Caesarea
keyEvents.description: Paul stayed with Philip the evangelist in Caesarea, where Philip's four unmarried daughters had the gift of prophecy.
